crossRefs.note: Now there arose a new king over Egypt, who didn’t know Joseph.
There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.
Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
“Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s…
I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.
For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can…

translations.web: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.
translations.bsb: Their love, their hate, and their envy have already vanished, and they will never again have a share in all that is done under the sun.
translations.kjv: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.
translations.asv: As well their love, as their hatred and their envy, is perished long ago; neither have they any more a portion for ever in anything that is done under the sun.
